ask.counteract.move_extension: This main move is {{n}} tiles, landing on {{tile}}. How many extra tiles?
ask.agent.text: {{who}} stopped at the dealer: settle one tile of the same colour -- buy an unowned one, or add a house to your own. You can also skip. If short on cash, you can mortgage other deeds to fund it.
ask.agent.title: Dealer · {{agent}}
ask.auction.text: Land price {{price}}{{extra}}. Minimum bid 100, raises of at least 100; the highest bidder pays and takes the deed. After a bid it waits 6 more seconds; with no new bid the deed is sold.
ask.auction.title: Auction: {{tile}}
ask.build.among: {{who}} may add a house ({{why}}) on one of {{n}} tiles
ask.build.text: {{who}} stopped on {{tile}}: pay {{cost}} to add a house?
ask.build.title: Build a house
ask.buy.text: {{who}} stopped on the unowned {{tile}}: buy it for {{price}}?{{extra}}
ask.buy.title: Buy deed
ask.circle.text_landed: {{who}} stopped on CiRCLE: pick a [CiRCLE reward] first -- the stop also draws 1 more card
ask.circle.title: CiRCLE reward
ask.counteract.title: [Counter]
ask.force_buy.text:
{{who}} stopped on {{owner}}'s mortgaged {{tile}}: mortgaged land charges no rent.
Pay {{owner}} {{price}} (twice the land price + houses) to force-buy it? The deed stays mortgaged.
ask.force_buy.title: Force buy
ask.mortgage.text:
{{what}}, still short {{need}}.
Pick deeds to mortgage: each pays half its land price. Mortgaged land charges no rent and cannot be built on; you can redeem it later for 60% of the land price.
ask.mortgage.title: Not enough money: mortgage deeds
ask.mortgage.optional:
This purchase/build costs {{amount}}; you still need {{need}}.
Mortgage other deeds to fund it, or cancel. Each pays half its land price; the deed being upgraded cannot fund its own construction.
ask.mulligan.text:
Shuffle all {{n}} cards in hand back into the draw pile and redraw {{n}}?
This is the only chance -- after the first turn starts it cannot be changed.
ask.mulligan.title: Opening hand
ask.part.auction_houses: , {{h}} houses on the tile (go to the winner)
ask.part.incl_tile_houses: (incl. the {{h}} houses already on the tile)
